properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 12 at 10:25PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 1025 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 7
miles southeast of Kiowa, or 38 miles west of Limon, moving northeast
at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and half inch size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Kiowa and Fondis.
